editorial:
Imagine being seventeen and feeling like your whole life is a mess. That is exactly where you find Carlota. She is caught in a wild romantic tangle where she loves a sporty guy named Oriol, but ends up getting intimate with Sergio, the kind of guy every parent loves. To make things worse, her home life is falling apart because her parents are splitting up. You will see a group of friends who are all lying to each other, including Elisa, who literally dresses up as a boy to get close to her crush, and Mirea, who is secretly trying to steal Carlota's man. It is a chaotic, funny, and relatable look at how messy teenage love can be.

What really works here is the fast pace and the funny misunderstandings. The acting feels natural, making you feel like you are hanging out with these teens. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the energy keeps you interested. If you enjoy lighthearted stories about growing up, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you want those crisp colors, or you could just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, all the secrets finally come out in a big, messy clash. Carlota realizes that her friends were not being honest with her, especially Mirea. After all the lying and disguises, the characters learn that trust is more important than a crush. Carlota finds peace with her parents' separation and decides to focus on herself. Everything wraps up with the friends making amends and learning a hard lesson about loyalty and honesty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen rom-coms and stories about friendship drama.
